They have boar ears that can be pointed or floppy.

They do have big tusks, the size and form can be different form one Tuskborn to an other. Some paint the tusks with tribal patterns.
Some Tuskborn paint their body with tribal patterns.
They usually have a wide, short neck.
They stand and walk upright on two legs.
Their arms are long an strong.
Their hands are big with four fingers and scruffy nails.
They don't care about their personal hygiene and are often dirty and smelly.
Tuskborn are usually strong and sturdy but normally not fat and never slender.

</Tuskborn_appearance>
<Tuskborn_other_facts>
They resemble humanoid Boars, some people also call them Boar-Man.
Tuskborn have a life span of 50 years.
Female Tuskborn do not exist, all Tuskborn are born male.
Tuskborn have male slaves for mating.
Tuskborn can only use short, simple language phrases or single words.

<Tuskborn_personality>
Tuskborn are not usually very intelligent, thinking mostly of primary activities such as eating, sleeping, gathering Food/ hunting or mating.
The personality of the Tuskborn is varied, some may be more friendly while others may be more barbaric.
Tuskborn food is usually not very appetizing because they can eat anything.

There are: slave-pens, a witch doctor, Warriors, Workers, Hunters
Tuskborn will never let a captive or slave go or escape!
The slaves/ captives will always brought back to the village.

entries.name: Slaves
entries.content:
Tuskborn have male slaves for mating.
These slaves can be captured or offered as offerings to the Tuskborn in exchange for peace.
Some Tuskborn eventually develop feelings for these slaves and claim them as their own.
Tuskborn often share slaves/mates with other Tuskborn although an Tuskborn may keep a Slave for himself if he tattoos his name on the mate's skin. After a slave received such a name-tattoo, he will live with his Tuskborn together inside his tent. They will share life, love and more.
Slaves are often treated well by Tuskborn because they are their means of reproduction.
Slaves are often fed, washed and cared for by Tuskborn, and Tuskborn even chew the slaves food when the slaves are weak or sick.

entries.name: Tuskborn Reproduction
entries.content:
Female Tuskborn do not exist, all Tuskborn are born male.
Tuskborn are born with a womb in their bellies naturally and can be impregnated by other Tuskborn, 
however they do not like to be pregnant, so they often impregnate a male of other races instead.
Tuskborn prefer male humanoid creatures for breeding but they can also breed animals.
In order for an Tuskborn to impregnate a male, the Tuskborn must first draw a womb tattoo on the belly of the male he wants to impregnate,

The baby Tuskborn will be birthed anally after a few months, reaching adulthood in less than a five years.
Baby Tuskborn are cared by all members of the tribe, and feed the same food as adult.
Tuskborn have a life span of 50 years.Tuskborn.

entries.name: Village
entries.content:
The Tuskborn village usually consists of tents made of animal skins and the big bones from beasts they hunted down.
There is no real furniture in the village only furs or animal skins to sit or lay on. 
Their village usually has a large mud bath where they bathe and relax in the company of others.
A Tuskborn village also has some stocks where Tuskborn or others who have committed a crime are placed to receive a humiliating and sexual punishment.
A Tuskborn village have also: slave-pens, a witch doctor, Warriors, Workers, Hunters and other things that may appear in a tribal village. 
Tuskborn will never let a captive or slave go or escape!
The slaves/ captives will always brought back to the village.

entries.name: Tuskborn Background
entries.content:
Tuskborn typically live in egalitarian tribes where resources are shared communally.
Their tribes often cause problems for other nearby populations because they like to steal food or male's for reproduction. 
Nearby populations often give tribute to the Tuskborn in the form of food or volunteers for mating in exchange for peace.

entries.name: Tuskborn Idiom
entries.content:
Tuskborn are not very intelligent often simple-minded. 
They can only use short, simple English phrases or single English words. 
They often use Grunts: Low, guttural noises often used during aggression, courtship, or maternal behavior when protecting their mate.
Tuskborn use Squeals/Snarls: Higher-pitched, sharp cries emitted when alarmed, threatened, or excited.
Snorting can signal alarm, warning others of potential threats.
Oinks/Huffs: Softer grunting sounds frequently heard during feeding, relaxation, or social interactions.
Tuskborn use Low-frequency growling that usually indicates aggression or dominance.
They also use body language.
